description: §22.12 (S459 round 4 F2) positive — a plain element takes any id (`title`, `hidden`), and a control outside a form any name (`name`): they create no named property that could shadow a member.
rationale: §22.12 *Named properties*: only `embed` / `form` / `iframe` / `img` / `object` (document) and controls / `img` inside a form are judged; every other element takes any `id` / `name`. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
